intro.title: Learn it: tens and ones!
intro.say: Let’s build numbers from tens and ones. A ten is a stick of ten blocks. Tap Start.

num: {name} has {t} bags of 10 marbles and {o} more. How many marbles?
{name} packs {t} boxes of 10 pencils and {o} more. How many pencils?
{name} stacks {t} towers of 10 blocks and {o} more. How many blocks?
ten: {name} has {n} marbles. Then {name} gets one more bag of 10. How many marbles now?
{name} has {n} stickers. A friend gives {name} a pack of 10 more. How many stickers now?
There are {n} shells in a bucket. {name} adds a row of 10 more. How many shells now?
add: {name} has {t} bags of 10 marbles and {o} more. Then {name} finds {b} more marbles. How many marbles now?
{name} has {t} boxes of 10 pencils and {o} more. Then {name} gets {b} more pencils. How many pencils now?
There are {t} trays of 10 lamingtons and {o} more on a plate. {name} bakes {b} more. How many lamingtons now?
{name} has {t} packs of 10 stickers and {o} more. A friend gives {name} {b} more. How many stickers now?
{name} counts {t} rows of 10 shells and {o} more. Then {name} finds {b} more shells. How many shells now?
